messages:
sara-sales: FinTrust flagged our KMS for the POC they want BYOK with HSM-backed keys (FIPS L3) or an approved compensating-controls plan.
jon-se: Do they need on-prem HSM or cloud HSM (CloudHSM/Import)?
marta: Questionnaire flags SIG/CAIQ key custody controls. For POC we can offer timeboxed compensating controls instead of full HSM deployment.
kevin-legal: Legal will only accept a scoped, time-limited waiver with audit rights + liability cap. No plaintext key export.
security-bot: Automated note: "Risk HIGH without HSM attestation. Recommend cross-account logging, customer-owned keys, immutable audit."
marta: Proposed POC controls (90 days): 1) Customer-managed keys (import or CloudHSM). 2) Cross-account CloudTrail -> S3 with object lock + replication to customer's account. 3) Alerts on GenerateDataKey/Admin events to customer and Redwood. 4) RBAC + MFA for key admins. 5) Data scope limits and short retention.
jon-se: Can eng stand up cross-account logging + alert lambda in 48hrs? Need a checklist to send customer.
marta: Yes. Minimal S3 policy for CloudTrail puts: {"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"Service":"cloudtrail.amazonaws.com"},"Action":"s3:PutObject","Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::redwood-poc-logs/*"}]}
kevin-legal: I'll draft a 1-page "POC BYOK Waiver (90 days)" addendum with compensating controls and auto-expiry.
sara-sales: I'll confirm FinTrust's chosen KMS/HSM vendor and request signature.
jon-se: Actions: sara get signature, marta implement logging+alerts and publish SE checklist, kevin post draft addendum, i'll update vendor-risk tracker.
sara-sales: On it ":thumbsup:"
marta: Scope exception to this POC only; auto-expire at 90 days unless renewed with security+legal sign-off.
kevin-legal: Will post draft here for review.
jon-se: Once signed, i'll mark as "approved-with-controls" in tracker. :white_check_mark:
